title: similarity/pairs/<a>--<b>--<variant>.json
description: Per-batch slot-pair DETAIL for one UNORDERED config-pair, lazy-loaded by /pair (DESIGN §5). For each slot-pair it carries the per-channel S value across all 17 channels (15 formal + the 2 permanent DIAGNOSTIC channels c-ncd / d-tagpath, which are DISPLAYED but never enter greedy pruning / statistics / hypothesis families, scheme §4). This is the run-level raw material that similarity/summary.json aggregates (median/IQR/n_eff) — i.e. matrices.json-equivalent content — so it ENTERS the §8 verify rehash: the runner MUST fix ONE canonical float serialization for every S value (CONTRACT-NOTES §8, recommend the manifest decimal-string grammar). RULED (DECISIONS-M0 §8): each unordered config-pair is materialized EXACTLY ONCE ((a,b)=(b,a) not duplicated; the matrix page renders the symmetric expansion). config_a precedes config_b in the manifest's persisted config order for cross pairs, and config_a==config_b for self pairs. JUDGMENT CALL (flagged): scheme fixes the per-channel S SEMANTICS byte-exactly (§4, appendix A) but not the pair-file JSON shape; the layout below is this contract's design. schema_version 1.0.0; file SHA256 + version frozen into lock (scheme §11).
$comment: schema_version: 1.0.0. Determinism caveat (FLAGGED): S values are typed as JSON numbers here for readability, but this file feeds a verify rehash — the runner MUST serialize every number with a single fixed canonical form (CONTRACT-NOTES §8). uniqueItems on pairs is whole-object only; (slot_a,slot_b) composite uniqueness is runner-enforced. Sharding (one file per pair vs grouped) is a runner choice (DATA-LAYOUT §1).

variant.description: Prompt variant this pair detail is computed over (scheme §9). Each variant has its own pair files.

config_a.description: First config of the unordered pair. For cross pairs (kind=cross) config_a PRECEDES config_b in the manifest's persisted config_ids order (§4). For self pairs config_a == config_b.

config_b.description: Second config of the unordered pair; == config_a for self.

kind.description: self = same config, slot pair set {(i,j)|i<j} = C(m,2); cross = distinct configs, A×B full cartesian, materialized once (scheme §5, DECISIONS-M0 §8).

channels.description: All 22 L2 channel names (scheme §4, v13), the exact key set of every pair's s object. Includes the 2 permanent diagnostics c-ncd / d-tagpath. Bounds are 17..22 (not 22..22) so pair documents written before the v13 x-* expansion still validate. NOTE 2026-07-25: v13 updated the s-object `required` list and the summary schema to 22 but left THIS array at 17/17 and the channelName enum at 17 names, so every 22-channel pair document written since has been invalid against the frozen schema — the production runner does not schema-validate pair docs at write time, only the tests do, which is why it went unseen.

pairs.description: One entry per slot-pair. Self: (slot_a, slot_b) with slot_a < slot_b over config's valid slots. Cross: every valid slot_a of config_a × every valid slot_b of config_b. Pairs are computed ONLY between valid slots (scheme §1.1/§5). (slot_a,slot_b) composite-key uniqueness is runner-enforced.

slot_b.description: Valid slot_index in config_b. For self pairs slot_a < slot_b.

s.description: Per-channel S for this slot-pair. Every one of the 22 channels present (v13); S in [0,1] by construction, or null when either side is a zero-vector / empty set / empty bag (scheme §4 'S=null'; double-empty is also null). c-ncd and d-tagpath values are DIAGNOSTIC (displayed, excluded from pruning/stats/hypotheses). The x-* family (v13) are formal code-feature-distribution cosine channels from card.html.

c-ncd.description: Diagnostic channel. sim = 1 − clamp(NCD_sym,0,1) (appendix A). The unclamped NCD_sym is stored in diagnostics.c_ncd_ncd_sym.

d-tagpath.description: Diagnostic channel (root→leaf tag path set Jaccard).

x-color.description: v13. Declared-color HSL-bucket histogram cosine (code-side palette).

x-semantics.description: v13. HTML semantic-profile (semantic ratios, depth) cosine.

diagnostics.description: Optional per-pair diagnostic companions the scheme requires stored alongside the mapped value (appendix A): the UNCLAMPED c-ncd NCD_sym ('未 clamp 并存') and the RAW v-ssim scalar ('raw 仅作诊断字段'). Present only when the corresponding channel S is non-null; never used in statistics.

c_ncd_ncd_sym.description: Unclamped symmetric NCD; MAY fall below 0 or exceed 1 (real compressors violate the normal-compressor axioms, so NCD_sym ∈ roughly [−ε, 1+ε]) — the diagnostic exists precisely to preserve this pre-clamp value ('未 clamp 并存', appendix A c-ncd), so it is intentionally unbounded on BOTH sides. The mapped c-ncd S = 1 − clamp(this,0,1).

v_ssim_raw.description: Raw structural_similarity scalar in [-1,1]; the mapped v-ssim S = clip((raw+1)/2,0,1).

allOf.$comment: appendix A c-ncd '未 clamp 并存': when the mapped c-ncd S is non-null the unclamped NCD_sym diagnostic MUST coexist.
appendix A v-ssim 'raw 仅作诊断字段': when the mapped v-ssim S is non-null the raw scalar diagnostic MUST coexist.

sValue.description: Similarity S in [0,1], or null (zero-vector / empty set / empty bag on either side; scheme §4). Determinism: runner fixes one canonical float serialization (CONTRACT-NOTES §8).
